conclusion.unsynchronized_public_shadow: Feeding only causal learner observations can leave the teacher believing that its proposed action was executed. An observed dead worker has no public next position from which to infer that last order.
conclusion.valid_training_adapter: Call one persistent, isolated original per learner seat/trajectory on every pre-action observation to get its natural proposal. Preserve it and its search telemetry. Once the actual own order is finalized, call _ST["tr"].set_actions(before_players, actual_order) on this same instance before the next public observation. Preserve _ST["prev"], live policy RNG, real search wall clocks, and other state. Assert expected intended destinations from independent physical torus arithmetic each time.
conclusion.scope: This aligns the action-conditioned belief to executed behavior at each successful step without modifying the source. It is an explicit white-box training adapter, not the public interface alone. Its labels are conditional on learner-visited histories; independent original self-play returns, entropy draws, costs, and exact repeatable choices do not follow.

fixture.role: The recorded original controlled this seat throughout. No new match, rollouts or original inference.

different_action_case.caveat: The differing order is a deliberately injected legal direction on the recorded original path, not a measured shadow teacher proposal.
